infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PlayMatch needs camera access to record your football highlights and take profile photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PlayMatch needs photo library access to upload your football highlights and profile photos.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PlayMatch needs microphone access to record audio for your football highlight videos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PlayMatch uses your location to find nearby football games and venues.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: PlayMatch can access your contacts to help you find friends who also play.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: PlayMatch can add your upcoming games to your calendar so you never miss a match.
